resweep.reason: measure_bands() had forked build-masks.py:116's line_groups() (LINE_MIN_INK 2 / LINE_GAP 4) instead of typeset-cards.py:721's measure_en_lines() (profile > 0, no gap tolerance). Ornament ink in the inter-line gaps kept every row above LINE_MIN_INK, so no gap was ever found and printed lines merged; the merged bands dragged the ink-weighted median band height up and inverted the 0.5..2.0 * en_ink_h filter, keeping plates and dropping text.
